text:
ali: Kicking off aviary-v1 embed onboarding. Focus: short query recall, typo noise, and Brazilian Portuguese. Running fp16 -> pcq int8 -> int4-lite.

nora: Datasets?

ali: MicroRecall-5k, Tatoeba en-pt, and a typo-augmented logs sample (5k). Clustering sanity with kmeans on 20k.

paul: Early numbers?

ali: recall@1 micro fp16 0.882 -> int8-pcq 0.871 -> int4 0.745. recall@5 fp16 0.948 -> int8 0.941 -> int4 0.89. Tatoeba pt recall@1 fp16 0.861 -> int8 0.838 -> int4 0.701.

nora: Short queries hit hardest?

ali: Yes. <6 tokens drop ~0.16 for int4. Cosine-shift median: en -0.010, pt -0.036, typos -0.085.

paul: Any tokenization issues?

ali: Some Portuguese contractions and emojis create outlier norms. I clipped at 99.9 percentile and int4 recall@1 +0.04 on typos.

ci-bot: CI: aviary-v1 tokenizer tests passed. Unit coverage 91%.

ali: Proposed actions: 1) run per-layer percentile sweep 99.9/99.99, 2) prototype hybrid int4-with-int8-outlier store, 3) add locale_cosine_delta metric to eval harness with alert at 0.035, 4) short-query fallback to int8-pcq.

paul: Agree. Also try 100-step last-layer recalibration on 1k pt samples (MSE distill) before rejecting quant. Often recovers a lot.

ali: Command I used:

```bash
redwood-embed --model aviary-v1 --input typos_pt.jsonl --quant int4:lite --batch 128 --out ./embs.npy
```

nora: Thanks. Attach failure pairs when you open the PR and I'll review runbook text. :thumbsup:

ali: Will do, posting results tomorrow.
